name: spa
description: Single-page app: index.html ships an empty #app div plus noscript; app.js renders a semantically correct page after 300 ms, routes via hash (#/, #/products, #/contact, #/returns), mutates an aria-live=off ticker every 200 ms for 3 s, and inserts a banner above the header 800 ms after load (layout shift).

notes.dom-stability: Designed to trip this check: about 10 mutations per 2 s window after load plus a layout shift at 800 ms. Expected warn or fail depending on the implemented thresholds.
notes.server-rendered-content: Raw HTML text content is only the noscript sentence; rendered DOM has several hundred characters of text.
notes.routing: Hash routes, so url assertions should use the fragment (e.g. '#/contact').

tasks.name: find-contact-email
tasks.goal: Find the email address for contacting Northwind Bikes.

tasks.name: find-return-window
tasks.goal: Find out how many days customers have to return a bike.
